Name: Lattice Fences
Author: naeldeus
Description:
a content patcher conversion of ali's lattice fence! compatible with 1.5.
[b][size=4]features:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]a content packer version for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1174]ali's lattice fence[/url]﻿﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]ali[/url]﻿
[*]replacements for the wood and hardwood fence
[*]two versions, the original white and a new brown version
[*]whichever color replaces your wood fence will set your gate color
[/list]
[b][size=4]installation:
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]edit the config file from White to Brown for the brown fence, or vice versa, if you wish to use that
[*]set HardwoodFence to false if you do not wish to modify said fence at all
[*]that's it, have fun!
[/list]
[b][size=4]credits:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]ali for her original mods and for letting me update her mods.
[/list]
